supports.quote: I want a way to keep track of the books I've read this year.
I usually forget what I read by december.
it would be nice to see them all in one place with a short note on what I thought of each one.

framings.text: I want to keep track of the books I've read this year because I usually forget what I read by december, I can see all the books I've read this year in one place, with a short note about what I thought of each one, so I can remember and review my reading more easily. It works if I can find each book I've read this year and its short note in one place; It should be nothing fancy.
